    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CentralServiceCenter" name="Central fridge service center" processRef="Process_CentralServiceCenter"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LocalFacility" name="Local service facility" processRef="Process_LocalFacility"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceRequest" name="Symptoms and fridge type" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Start_CenterReceivesRequest" messageRef="Message_ServiceRequest"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer process" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequest" name="Send symptoms and fridge type" messageRef="Message_ServiceRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAppointment" name="Receive appointment details" messageRef="Message_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRepairNotice" name="Receive notice that the fridge is repaired" messageRef="Message_RepairComplete"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RateService" name="Rate the service facility?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RateFacility" name="Rate the service facility"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RatingMerge" name="Continue after rating choice"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerComplete" name="Customer process complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_FridgeNoises" targetRef="Task_DescribeSymptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_DescribeSymptoms" targetRef="Task_SendRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAppointment" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRepairNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRepairNotice" targetRef="Task_ConfirmFridgeOK"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmFridgeOK" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_RateService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Rate" name="Rate" sourceRef="Gateway_RateService" targetRef="Task_RateFacility">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_NoRating" name="Do not rate" sourceRef="Gateway_RateService" targetRef="Gateway_RatingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_10" sourceRef="Task_RateFacility" targetRef="Gateway_RatingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_11" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingMerge" targetRef="End_CustomerComplete"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CentralServiceCenter" name="Central service center process" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Center_3" sourceRef="Task_SendFacilityRequest" targetRef="End_Center"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_LocalFacility" name="Local service facility process" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAppointment" name="Send appointment details" messageRef="Message_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FacilityArrival" name="Service facility arrives at a random time"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessRepairNeeds" name="Assess repair requirements"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsNeeded" name="Are additional parts needed?"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LeaveWithoutRepair" name="Left without repairing the fridge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairFridge" name="Repair the fridge"/>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive confirmation that the fridge is OK" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FacilityComplete" name="Service confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_1" sourceRef="Start_FacilityReceivesRequest" targetRef="Task_MakeAppointment"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_Leave" sourceRef="Task_LeaveForParts" targetRef="End_LeaveWithoutRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_NoParts" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsNeeded" targetRef="Task_RepairFridge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_6" sourceRef="Task_RepairFridge" targetRef="Task_SendRepairNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_7" sourceRef="Task_SendRepairNotice" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_8" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="End_FacilityComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

rules.instruction: When the description says that a participant will arrive at an unpredictable time before work can proceed: model waiting for that arrival as an intermediate catch event, followed by the work performed upon arrival.
rules.situation: the description says that a participant will arrive at an unpredictable time before work can proceed

rules.instruction: When the description states an activity or outcome and identifies its action, object, actor, or recipient: label the corresponding BPMN element with concise wording that preserves those stated details and does not substitute a different action or meaning
rules.situation: the description identifies the specific action, object, recipient, decision, or outcome represented by a BPMN element

rules.instruction: When the description names a distinct activity or outcome and states its action or completion condition: Label the corresponding BPMN element with the described action or outcome. Do not replace it with a broader or narrower action, or add detail the description does not support.
rules.situation: the description states distinct activities, decisions, or outcomes

rules.instruction: When the description specifies successive activities or a transition into or out of a decision or synchronization point: Connect the corresponding flow nodes with sequence flows so the modeled paths preserve the described order and branch continuation.
rules.situation: the description states that activities, events, or gateways occur in a particular order
